name: ConsolePort (controller support, client add-on)
description: New: play with a controller: the ConsolePortLK Enhanced add-on, copied into your CoA client's Interface/AddOns; nothing is written to the server. On a Steam Deck, Steam Input sends its keys; in game type /cp recalibrate once. Not yet tested on Conquest of Azeroth's own class and talent windows. Not yet tested on a Steam Deck: tell us on Discord if something is off.
notes: FOLLOWS RELEASES (T126): Install and Update take the newest published release's commit,
not the branch tip. ConsolePortLK Enhanced publishes versioned releases (v1.0.4-v1.0.6);
the release's own digest proves the download.
Play with a controller: the whole checkout is NOT copied, only the eight add-on folders
WoW reads (the repo root holds assets/, tests/, docs and the .toc files' siblings).
Two names are left behind (T65): `.git`, whose 0444 pack files made every second install
of a `src: "."` addon die with Errno 13 before it had landed a file, and this app's own
`.yulon-clone.json`. Both are bookkeeping, the history stays in the clone, and the client
OPT-IN (T855): nothing puts this add-on into your client without a press. It is not among
the default add-ons, so Play and a fresh install leave the client alone until the Modules
tab's own Install. A Remove is remembered per server and nothing puts the add-on back;
installing it by hand lifts that. Nothing is written to the server and nothing is restarted.
"Check for updates" counts only `modules/`, so this `mods` item gets no update count; a
manual Update follows releases. Interface 30300 (Wrath 3.3.5a) against this entry's 30300
CoA client, which Yu'lon itself keeps current. Credit: ConsolePortLK Enhanced by SuttonX,
